scope: Exact-head six-platform companion unit/CLI/protocol/bundle checks and real 14-workflow native toolchain probes, plus Arch userspace. Physical FPGA programming and clean-machine installer acceptance are not exercised. Browser HDL acceptance is retained separately.
source_hash_note: The same Git commit is checked out on every host. Source byte hashes are retained per platform; Windows checkout CRLF bytes differ from POSIX LF hashes.
supplement_note: Package discovery/preflight workflow_support labels are not execution verdicts. The workflow_results above retain actual execution outcomes and log hashes, including explicit externally managed prerequisites and Windows x64 translation.
result_note: All six platform toolchain suites and Arch userspace passed all 14 real HDL workflows, including Intel macOS Cocotb VHDL and Windows ARM64 x64 translation. Four Native Linux/macOS unit, CLI, protocol, bundle and smoke jobs passed. Both Windows Native jobs failed only the symlink-chain-dot-dot archive rejection test after 264 unit tests; later native steps were skipped. A portable archive graph validation correction requires a complete subsequent native run before complete acceptance.

previous_attempts.result_note: Five toolchain platform targets plus Arch now passed all 14 workflows, including the new Windows x64/ARM64 and Linux ARM64 supplements. Intel macOS reached 13/14 with one diagnosed Cocotb loader failure. Four native job rows failed only new canonical-path assertions; Linux x64/ARM64 native jobs passed. This report does not claim complete native acceptance.
